blocks.raw: <ExamTip>Memorize these CPD numbers: 45 credits every 3 years (average 15/year), distributed across 5 professional track areas. No annual minimum is mandated — you may complete requirements unevenly as long as the three-year total is achieved. Failure = PIC renewal denial.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>An architect without a valid, renewed PIC CANNOT legally practice architecture, sign and seal documents, or execute professional services — regardless of employment status. Expired PIC = no practice authorization. Maintain current CPD completion to avoid interruption.</Tip>
